title: Predictors of professional responses in nonprofit mental health forums: interpretable machine learning analysis
core_idea: Examine how textual features (topic, sentiment, title length, content length) and contextual features (page views, posting time) of user inquiries in nonprofit mental health forums influence the quantity and length of responses from mental health professionals, using machine learning models and explainability (SHAP) to identify key predictive features.
tldr: Interpretable ML applied to forum Q&A data to determine how post content and metadata predict how many and how long professionals respond, with the goal of informing community design and posting strategies.
